name: Stop on your verse

note: Stop on your verse reel posted; all checked frames matched the plan
caption:
Hold to stop, then tell us the verse you landed on.

Forty-five verses about joy, light for the path, stillness before God, and a Lord who is good to those who wait for Him. Every one of these is true, so whichever one you stop on, you can lean on it today.

45 verses from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB)
